Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.chart

Class CartesianChart

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.chart.CartesianChart
public final class CartesianChart extends Object
A chart drawn on cartesian axes (bars, lines, areas, scatter), once every line is parsed and every implicit value resolved: the categories (1, 2, ..., n when none is given), the ranges of the value axes fitted to the data, the series as they are plotted. It is built by ChartDiagram.resolveCartesian() and read by the renderers, graphic or text, which do not need to know how it was written.

Whatever the orientation, the "category" axis holds the categories (or the numeric h-axis of coordinate pairs), and the "value" axis the values: for a horizontal chart, the categories go down the left side and the values along the bottom.
